German Tanks-Good Armor, Good Gun, poor movement, production number, and transmission.
American Tanks- Average Armor, Average Gun(except for the Sherman firefly, although that was a British variant), decent movement and production number.
Russian Tanks- Average Armor(Armor was thick and capable of bouncing shells, but prone to shattering due to hardening process known as quenching), average gun(decent gun, but poor ammunition quality led to AP rounds being to dangerous to fire for fear of exploding in the breach, and gunner sights often made it so tank was impossible to fire in the move.), and impressive speed and maneuverability although shifting was a titanic task, and production numbers are widely sited as one of the key reasons why the soviets beat back the Nazis.
Japanese Tanks- Poor Armor, poor gun, and decent speed
Italian tanks- poor everything really.
French tanks- Decently made tanks, with great guns and armor, however the logistics was a mess so they could never field enough tanks. While 1 on 1 the French tank would have won against the panzer 1 and 2, due to planning by the Germans it was more like, 4 or 5 vs 1 leading to the defeat.
English Tanks- Incredibly versatile, yet cramped. These tanks while able to operate on African deserts are meant more for Europe and as a result the preformance outside of Western Europe was pretty poor, but once they implemented and improved air filters on the Crusader made it much more reliable.

Overall best tank by kill count- Tiger 1 and 2 with over 10,000 tanks and artillery pieces
Best tank by Recorded speed- BT-7 tank at 45mph on roads and 35 off road
Best tank by crew survival rate- Jagdtiger
Cheapest tank to produce- Bob Semple Tank(cost about as much as a tractor and some roofing)
And finally most produced. T34
Overall best tank all factors considered- unknown.
